import unittest

from boltons.setutils import IndexedSet


class IndexedSetSliceRegressionTest(unittest.TestCase):

    def test_positive_slices_after_removals_match_list(self):
        indexed = IndexedSet(range(20))
        indexed.remove(2)
        indexed.remove(7)
        current = list(indexed)

        slices = [
            slice(1, 6),
            slice(3, 12),
            slice(-8, -2),
            slice(2, -3),
            slice(-12, 14),
            slice(None, None, 2),
            slice(1, 15, 3),
            slice(-100, 100, 2),
        ]
        for item_slice in slices:
            with self.subTest(item_slice=item_slice):
                result = indexed[item_slice]
                self.assertIsInstance(result, IndexedSet)
                self.assertEqual(list(result), current[item_slice])

    def test_negative_step_semantics_use_apparent_bounds(self):
        indexed = IndexedSet(range(20))
        indexed.remove(2)
        indexed.remove(7)

        self.assertEqual(list(indexed[-8:-2:-2]), [9, 6, 4])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
